title: Free agreement allows a changing view

captions.energy: Choosing understanding with both people involved

meaning: Ending an explanation that demands permanently identical taste can preserve freely chosen agreement within your changing shared view.
text: Shared understanding can remain close while personal responses change. The Lovers in the energy position of Ajna supports free choice involving both people. Death in the physical position ends an exhausted account of shared taste. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions feels familiar agreement become fluid. Your view can preserve connection without demanding repetition of the same impression, allowing the truth of earlier enjoyment to coexist with a different present response.

For example, you discuss a song you once equally enjoyed. One now hears weariness in its familiar chorus while the other still enjoys the melody. **Ending an old formula leaves agreement free to change.** You stop explaining common ground through compulsory matching taste. Instead, you can choose to consider what each actually hears now. Your view gains content. Change feels unfamiliar, yet earlier pleasure remains true for its time. Present differences need neither cancel it nor decide in advance what another listening will be like.

The risk is turning freedom of choice into an obligation to find another identical impression immediately. The ended formula returns under a fresh name. Choosing understanding together preserves scale. Attention to different responses is now shared. Your view stays alive when taste may move and each change need not confirm or disprove the entire earlier picture of common experience.
